About Me

Bridging Regulatory Complexity
with Strategic Execution

Founder - NEST EFFECT Group. With over 15 years of experience leading enterprise risk management frameworks, data analytics, and regulatory compliance programs, I help organisations navigate high-stakes environments — building resilient governance structures and transforming complex operational data into actionable executive insights.

As a Professional Speaker, MC, and Trainer, I regularly engage executive teams, board members, and industry audiences, translating intricate risk data into compelling, actionable strategic narratives. My background spans major Australian telecommunications, insurance governance, and federal enforcement environments, alongside extensive multi-country program leadership.
